notes: map_xy is normalized (0..1) position on the Prythian map image the user supplied (not committed). Regions marked playable_in_m1 are built in Milestone 1.

mortal_forest.name: The Winter Forest
mortal_forest.mood: A labyrinth of snow and ice. Pale low winter light, bramble thickets, a frozen brook, wolves' territory to the north.
mortal_forest.lighting: Low cold sun from the south-west, long blue shadows, god rays through pines, drifting snow, dusk to deep blue.

archeron_cottage.name: The Archeron Cottage
archeron_cottage.mood: A dilapidated two-room stone cottage, faded ward-markings at the threshold, Feyre's chipped painted flowers on every surface.
archeron_cottage.lighting: Hearth firelight, flickering, warm against the blue night outside the shutters.

mortal_village.name: The Village
mortal_village.mood: Ordinary, dull stone houses made grimmer by winter. Trampled brown snow. A tiny market square with a broken fountain.
mortal_village.lighting: Flat overcast morning; cold grey with warm stall lanterns.

the_wall.name: The Wall
the_wall.mood: An invisible ward bisecting the world, raised by the Treaty five centuries ago. Holes in it let faeries through.
the_wall.lighting: Moonlight and a shimmering seam of pale magic.

spring_manor.name: The Spring Court Manor
spring_manor.mood: An estate veiled in roses and ivy, alabaster sides, patios and balconies. Eternal spring.

spring_woods.name: The Spring Woods
spring_woods.mood: Balmy woods, birch groves and clear streams; something cold moves through them.

under_the_mountain.name: Under the Mountain
under_the_mountain.mood: Oppressive, torchlit, cold stone; a throne room of revels; mud trenches; cells dripping water.
under_the_mountain.lighting: Torches only. Heavy darkness, red accents.

chateau.name: Father's Estate
chateau.mood: A white marble house under emerald roofs, flame-clipped hedges, a drive lined with irises, Elain's garden under the study window.
chateau.lighting: Warm, flat summer light over green fields; colored glass lanterns on the night of the ball.
